summary.headline: Venetian Astrological Manuscript Catalog
summary.text: Catalog entries for Marcianus 303 and Marcianus 313 describe manuscripts containing works and commentaries by Euclid, Theon, Proclus, Ptolemy, Diophantus, Paul of Alexandria, Hipparchus, Ammonius or John Philoponus, Maximus Planudes, Heliodorus, and Dorotheus of Sidon. Listed materials include a clearer treatment of Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, the Ptolemaei Fructus, an astrolabe exposition, Indian calculation, zodiac signs, planetary observations, and the epithets of the seven stars.
